encoding: bincode 1.3 `serialize` defaults: fixed-width integers, little-endian, u64 sequence/string length prefixes, u32 enum variant tags, 1-byte Option tag, no length prefix on fixed-size arrays
note: Key order is by UTF-8 bytes. The `café` entry pairs a precomposed key with a decomposed value: a port that normalizes either one produces different bytes.
scenario: set("名前", Some(String("café 日本語 🚀 مرحبا")))
set("café", Some(String("cafe\u{301}")))  // composed key, decomposed value
